description: Find customer accounts (groups such as workspaces or companies) with plan, billing status, MRR and activity for a period. Pass needsAttention: true for the accounts the team should act on, with why and what to do. Pass search with a company name or domain to find one account, active or not. Use get_account for one account.

from.description: Inclusive start of the measurement period; pair with to instead of preset.

groupType.description: Group type, matching the group_<type> event property, e.g. workspace or company; email_domain groups signed-in users by work email domain. Omit to use the type with the most accounts.

limit.description: Most accounts to return, most active first.

needsAttention.description: Only the accounts the team should act on, the most pressing first, whether or not they were active in the period: failing payments, cancellations, paying accounts gone quiet, trials ending, plan limits. Each comes with attention.

offset.description: Accounts to skip; pass the previous page's nextOffset.

preset.description: Date preset such as last_7d. Alternative to from/to; defaults to last_30d.

search.description: Text to find in an account's key, name, domain or website, such as a company name or domain. Finds accounts whether or not they were active in the period.

to.description: Inclusive end of the measurement period; pair with from instead of preset.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

name: list_accounts

outputSchema.description: Without search, accounts are sorted by active days, then events; with search, exact matches come first, then the most recently updated, across every type unless groupType is given. With needsAttention, accounts of one type come acting now first, then by MRR, each with attention: act (now when money or the relationship is at stake this week, soon when following up this month would help), the reasons last night's rules found, and its last review's headline and next step, null until it is reviewed; needingAttention is how many accounts do in all. billingStatus is a Stripe-style status such as past_due or trialing; mrr is in the account's billing currency. hasMore says more accounts follow; pass nextOffset as offset for them. A search has no pages, so narrow it instead. groupTypes lists every type sent with group(); hint explains an empty or cut-off result.

title: List accounts
